# AirMic

> Use an iPhone as a wireless microphone for a Linux computer. The iPhone app streams its mic over local Wi-Fi to `airmic`, a Rust daemon that exposes a PipeWire microphone called "AirMic". Open source, MIT, no accounts or cloud.

## Install

- [Agent install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/docs/agent-install.md): step by step instructions for an AI agent installing AirMic for a user
- [Install script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/install.sh): one command install of the latest release, no sudo
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/README.md): install, CLI reference and troubleshooting for people
- [iPhone app install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/docs/ios-install.md): sideload the app from Xcode on a Mac

## Develop

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents working on this repo
- [Product plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/docs/PRD.md): architecture and milestones
- [Wire protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/docs/protocol.md): phone to computer protocol
- [Daemon IPC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhiejam/airmic/main/docs/ipc.md): JSON-RPC over the Unix socket that the CLI uses
